sources.title: RFC 7938 — Use of BGP for Routing in Large-Scale Data Centers

claim.en: Sections 3–4 discuss traditional and Clos designs, and L3-only networks with L2 domains confined toward the edge. Informational operational experience, not a universal size threshold.
claim.zh: 第3–4节讨论传统与Clos设计，以及将二层域限制于边缘的纯三层网络。这是经验性信息文档，不是通用规模门槛。

sources.title: Juniper — EVPN with VXLAN Data Plane Encapsulation

claim.en: EVPN provides control-plane learning; VXLAN supplies an L2 overlay over an IP network. Overlay segmentation may serve multitenancy and required L2 connectivity; platform support remains vendor-specific.
claim.zh: EVPN提供控制平面学习，VXLAN在IP网络上承载二层覆盖。覆盖分段可服务多租户和必要的二层连接；具体平台能力仍须核实。

sources.title: Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure Design Guide

claim.en: ACI illustrates controller-coordinated policy and tenant/VRF/bridge-domain constructs. It is a vendor-specific example, not a requirement for every controller fabric. Validate controller lifecycle, policy dependencies and licensing separately.
claim.zh: ACI展示控制器协调策略及租户、VRF、桥接域模型。这是特定厂商的示例，不代表所有控制器Fabric。须单独核实控制器生命周期、策略依赖和许可。

strengths.en: Familiar VLAN/routing boundaries can suit stable, modest change requirements.
strengths.zh: 熟悉的VLAN与路由边界适合变化较少的需求。

weaknesses.en: Broad L2 domains and manual change processes need explicit loop, failure-domain and change-control review.
weaknesses.zh: 较大的二层域和人工变更需要明确审查环路、故障域与变更控制。

complexity.en: Lower overlay learning burden; physical redundancy and L2 behavior still need design.
complexity.zh: 覆盖网络学习负担较低，但物理冗余与二层行为仍须设计。

skillsRequired.en: VLAN, routing, loop prevention and failure testing.

scalability.en: No device, MAC, VLAN or throughput capacity is inferred from inventory counts. Validate platform limits and topology.
scalability.zh: 不由资产数量推断设备、MAC、VLAN或吞吐上限。须核实平台限制和拓扑。

operationalRisk.en: Conditional risk: manual changes and wider L2 fault domains may increase troubleshooting scope.
operationalRisk.zh: 条件风险：人工变更和较大二层故障域可能扩大排障范围。

migration.en: Map VLAN gateways and dependencies; test staged gateway moves and rollback before cutover.
migration.zh: 梳理VLAN网关和依赖；切换前测试分阶段网关迁移与回退。

strengths.en: IP routing and ECMP can provide repeatable paths without introducing an L2 overlay.
strengths.zh: IP路由和ECMP可提供可重复的路径，无须引入二层覆盖。

weaknesses.en: This defined candidate cannot meet an explicit cross-rack L2 requirement; adding overlay changes the candidate.
weaknesses.zh: 此候选定义无法满足明确的跨机架二层需求；加入覆盖后已是另一候选。

complexity.en: Requires routed underlay addressing, routing policy and ECMP operations.
complexity.zh: 需要底层地址规划、路由策略与ECMP运维。

skillsRequired.en: BGP or chosen IGP, addressing, ECMP and route convergence verification.
skillsRequired.zh: BGP或所选IGP、地址规划、ECMP与路由收敛验证。

scalability.en: No rack/server count proves forwarding table, oversubscription or link capacity.
scalability.zh: 机架或服务器数量不能证明转发表、超售比或链路容量充足。

operationalRisk.en: Conditional risk: routing policy and addressing mistakes can affect reachability; validate failure paths.
operationalRisk.zh: 条件风险：路由策略和地址错误可能影响可达性；须验证故障路径。

migration.en: Confirm applications tolerate routed boundaries and renumbering; stage adjacency and gateway changes.
migration.zh: 确认应用可接受路由边界及地址变更；分阶段迁移邻接与网关。

strengths.en: Separates overlay services from routed transport where segmentation or within-fabric L2 extension is required.
strengths.zh: 在需要分段或Fabric内二层延伸时，将覆盖业务与路由传输分离。

weaknesses.en: Adds VTEP, VNI, control-plane and MTU dependencies that do not disappear with automation.
weaknesses.zh: 增加VTEP、VNI、控制平面和MTU依赖，自动化不会消除这些依赖。

complexity.en: Operate underlay and overlay together; distinguish control-plane state from actual forwarding evidence.
complexity.zh: 联合运维底层与覆盖；区分控制平面状态与真实转发证据。

skillsRequired.en: BGP EVPN routes, VXLAN encapsulation, tenant mapping and end-to-end MTU validation.
skillsRequired.zh: BGP EVPN路由、VXLAN封装、租户映射与端到端MTU验证。

scalability.en: Verify VNI/MAC/route limits and interoperability against exact platforms; no universal threshold is inferred.
scalability.zh: 按具体平台核实VNI、MAC、路由限制与互通，不推断通用门槛。

operationalRisk.en: Conditional risk: mapping drift and underlay/overlay interaction require correlated evidence.
operationalRisk.zh: 条件风险：映射漂移及底层与覆盖交互需要关联证据。

migration.en: Inventory VLAN/VNI/VRF mapping, gateways and MTU; rehearse coexistence, rollback and forwarding checks.
migration.zh: 盘点VLAN/VNI/VRF映射、网关与MTU；演练共存、回退和转发验证。

strengths.en: Central policy coordination can suit a team prepared to adopt and govern its policy model.
strengths.zh: 集中策略协调适合愿意采用并治理其策略模型的团队。

weaknesses.en: Controller/platform lifecycle, licensing and ecosystem dependence need explicit review.
weaknesses.zh: 必须明确审查控制器与平台生命周期、许可及生态依赖。

complexity.en: Policy abstractions and controller lifecycle add learning and operating responsibilities.
complexity.zh: 策略抽象与控制器生命周期增加学习和运维责任。

skillsRequired.en: Chosen platform policy model, tenant/VRF segmentation, API/change governance and recovery practice.
skillsRequired.zh: 所选平台策略模型、租户/VRF分段、API变更治理与恢复实践。

scalability.en: Check exact controller, fabric, endpoint and license limits; this is not an ACI sizing tool.
scalability.zh: 核实具体控制器、Fabric、终端与许可限制；此工具不是ACI容量规划器。

operationalRisk.en: Conditional risk: policy errors and platform coupling need governance; no data-plane outage is inferred from controller loss alone.
operationalRisk.zh: 条件风险：策略错误与平台耦合需要治理；不能仅因控制器失联推断数据平面中断。

migration.en: Translate existing policy and dependencies into the target model; validate licensing, coexistence and rollback.
migration.zh: 将现有策略与依赖转换至目标模型；验证许可、共存与回退。

body.en: If applications accept routed boundaries and no overlay segmentation is required, VXLAN introduces VTEP/VNI/MTU and control-plane work without a declared requirement. First document the missing capability, then justify the added layer. Preference scores alone cannot establish cost or benefit.
body.zh: 如果应用接受路由边界且不需要覆盖分段，VXLAN会增加VTEP、VNI、MTU和控制平面工作，却没有明确需求支撑。先记录缺少的能力，再论证新增层次；偏好评分不能证明成本收益。

body.en: A routed fabric can be a candidate when applications tolerate subnet boundaries and no cross-rack L2 service is required. Verify addressing, ECMP behavior, failure paths and actual link capacity. Counts here do not validate any of those engineering properties.
body.zh: 当应用接受子网边界且不要求跨机架二层业务时，路由Fabric可以作为候选。须验证地址、ECMP行为、故障路径和真实链路容量；此处数量不能验证这些工程属性。

body.en: Required overlay segmentation or within-fabric L2 extension can justify evaluating EVPN/VXLAN. Validate service-to-VNI/VRF mapping, supported routes, MTU and multivendor behavior. A positive rating is not evidence that a particular platform meets the requirement.
body.zh: 必要的覆盖分段或Fabric内二层延伸可以构成评估EVPN/VXLAN的理由。须验证业务到VNI/VRF映射、路由支持、MTU与跨厂商行为。正评分不是具体平台满足需求的证据。

title.zh: 何时控制器Fabric复杂度值得引入

body.en: Evaluate a controller fabric when consistent policy coordination and lifecycle governance are valuable and the team can operate the chosen model. ACI is one vendor-specific example. Compare licensing, APIs, recovery, ecosystem coupling and training before selecting; do not assume every controller fabric has identical behavior.
body.zh: 当一致的策略协调与生命周期治理具有价值，且团队能运维所选模型时，可评估控制器Fabric。ACI只是特定厂商示例。选择前比较许可、API、恢复、生态耦合与培训，不假设所有控制器Fabric行为相同。

body.en: Migration difficulty remains UNASSESSED: the current topology, maintenance windows and application dependencies were not collected. Inventory gateways, addressing and policy; test coexistence, failure recovery and rollback. Plan a pilot with measurable acceptance criteria and operational ownership before expanding.
body.zh: 迁移难度保持“未评估”：未收集现有拓扑、维护窗口与应用依赖。盘点网关、地址和策略，测试共存、故障恢复与回退。扩大范围前，制定具有可测验收条件和运维负责人的试点。
